events.name: onChipClose
events.description: Fired when the chip's remove control is activated. Carries no detail payload; read the chip's own properties from `event.target`.

cssProperties.description: Gap between label and icon. Defaults to `space-xs`.
cssProperties.name: --al-chip-gap

cssProperties.description: Defaults to `pointer`; set `default` for a non-interactive chip.
cssProperties.name: --al-chip-cursor

variant.description:
Variant — an EMPHASIS axis, matching `al-button`. Status is not on this
axis: `al-badge` and `al-alert` carry info/success/warning/danger.
- **default** the resting outlined pill (the `tertiary` treatment)
- **primary** a chip filled with the primary role
- **secondary** a chip filled with the secondary role
- **tertiary** an outlined chip on a transparent ground
- **neutral** a low-emphasis filled chip
- **bare** no fill and no border

isDismissible.description:
Dismissible property
- **true** Adds an X to hide the chip on click
- **false** Hides the X so the chip can not be hidden

isDismissed.description:
Is dismissed property
- **true** Hides the chip
- **false** Shows the chip
